titre: Le volume de boissons de PepsiCo en Amérique du Nord
sous_titre: Variation du volume unitaire du segment boissons Amérique du Nord, en %, de 2024 au premier semestre 2026

2024.texte: Unit volume declined 3%, driven by a 4% decline in non-carbonated beverage (NCB) volume and a 2% decline in CSD volume.

2025.texte: Unit volume declined 3%, driven by a 6% decline in non-carbonated beverage volume and a slight decline in CSD volume.

S1 2026.texte: Unit volume declined 3%, primarily driven by a 3% decline in CSD volume and a 3.5% decline in NCB volume.
